A notification, a recording fetch, a workflow wakeup and a bulk import are all handed to a background worker, and every one of them fails silently \u2014 no screen turns red, the work simply never happens. This page is where that silence is visible.", "col": 12}, "id": "j1"}, {"type": "header", "data": {"text": "Status now", "col": 12}, "id": "j2"}, {"type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The three figures on the left are the ones to read first, and every one of them is healthy at zero. A halted scheduler freezes every timed job on the site. A lane holding work that no worker process serves will never drain however long it is left \u2014 a lane with no work and no worker is invisible here, by design. Jobs Failed is the failed registry, which holds about a week: an accumulation to work through, not a live figure.", "col": 12}, "id": "j3"}, {"type": "number_card", "data": {"number_card_name": "Scheduler Halted", "col": 4}, "id": "j4"}, {"type": "number_card", "data": {"number_card_name": "Lanes Without a Worker", "col": 4}, "id": "j5"}, {"type": "number_card", "data": {"number_card_name": "Jobs Failed (Retained)", "col": 4}, "id": "j6"}, {"type": "number_card", "data": {"number_card_name": "Jobs Queued Now", "col": 4}, "id": "j7"}, {"type": "number_card", "data": {"number_card_name": "Errors Today", "col": 4}, "id": "j8"}, {"type": "number_card", "data": {"number_card_name": "Errors 7d", "col": 4}, "id": "j9"}, {"type": "header", "data": {"text": "Shape of the queue", "col": 12}, "id": "j10"}, {"type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Queue Lanes puts work waiting beside workers serving, per lane, so a deep lane with no bar beside it names its own problem. Jobs In Flight is every job this site holds in redis. Scheduled Jobs is the roster split on the one flag that decides whether a job is enqueued at all. Errors per Day is the trend behind the counts above.", "col": 12}, "id": "j11"}, {"type": "chart", "data": {"chart_name": "Queue Lanes", "col": 6}, "id": "j12"}, {"type": "chart", "data": {"chart_name": "Errors per Day", "col": 6}, "id": "j13"}, {"type": "chart", "data": {"chart_name": "Jobs In Flight", "col": 6}, "id": "j14"}, {"type": "chart", "data": {"chart_name": "Scheduled Jobs", "col": 6}, "id": "j15"}, {"type": "header", "data": {"text": "Live", "col": 12}, "id": "j16"}, {"type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Control Tower is one read of the whole platform \u2014 workers, queue depth, scheduler, redis, disk and this app's own halves \u2014 ending in a verdict and a flat list of problems. RQ Jobs is the queue itself, refreshing every fifteen seconds, filterable by lane and status, and a failed job carries its traceback on the row. RQ Workers is the processes: which lanes each one serves, its heartbeat and its failure count.", "col": 12}, "id": "j17"}, {"type": "shortcut", "data": {"shortcut_name": "Control Tower", "col": 4}, "id": "j18"}, {"type": "shortcut", "data": {"shortcut_name": "RQ Jobs", "col": 4}, "id": "j19"}, {"type": "shortcut", "data": {"shortcut_name": "RQ Workers", "col": 4}, "id": "j20"}, {"type": "header", "data": {"text": "History", "col": 12}, "id": "j21"}, {"type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Job Roster is every scheduled job with its frequency, whether it is stopped and how long it has been quiet, the longest-silent first \u2014 a stopped job is not promoted, because the ones stopped here are deliberate.
